prompt:
For many people, shopping has become a way of spending free time rather than something done only when goods are needed.

Why is this happening? Is it a positive or a negative development?
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: Both questions must be answered separately: first the reasons, then whether it is a positive or negative development

Reasons: shopping venues being designed together with cafés, cinemas and play areas, a cheap and constantly refreshed flow of products, being an indoor and comfortable meeting place, browsing turning into entertainment
Positive side: a cheap social activity, a safe meeting point in any weather, local employment and lively trade
Negative side: unneeded purchases and increased waste, wasted money and time, free time becoming tied to spending, those who cannot spend being left out
A clear judgement should be given at the end
common_mistakes: Slipping into an online-versus-store comparison and missing the actual topic
Writing the reasons but not giving the positive/negative judgement
Using real shop or brand names
